NetBox ID on Task Cards & Drilldowns

Service (Restore) and NetBox Pickup tickets now show the netbox device ID as their identifier — on the feed card, the pickup list, and the drilldown top bar — matching the Device ID inside each drilldown. The old locality (“· Sector X”) line is removed from every card.
open_in_new PR #463
Home Feed 4 Screens 03 Jul 2026
Service & Pickup cards — netbox ID Service drilldown — top-bar netbox ID Pickup card — netbox ID Pickup drilldown — top-bar netbox ID

What Changed

  • Locality removed: The · Sector X locality suffix is gone from every task card on the home feed.
  • Service & Pickup identifier: Restore (Service) and NetBox Pickup cards now render the netbox device ID (e.g. WBOX-abc-001, WBOX-a1b2c3-001) in place of the opaque task hash. Install and other families keep #<hash>.
  • Drilldown top bar: The full netbox device ID now appears in the drilldown top bar for Service and Pickup tickets — the pickup drilldown previously showed no ID at all.
  • Consistency: Card → list → drilldown header → the Device ID row inside the drilldown all show the same netbox ID.
  • Plumbing: Added device_id to the feed card DTO, mapped it to TaskDetail.deviceId; mock feed updated so the demo matches the drilldown Device ID.
